sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You emphasise both your skilled team and our long relationship; it sounds like preserving that continuity matters as much as the price adjustment. We value that partnership and want a lasting agreement that recognises wage pressure in proportion to its share of your costs. How can contract duration and payment timing best support that stability for you?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 48.92 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We value your commitment to a 24-month contract, as long-term stability is indeed important to our family-run foundry.
However, to sustain this stability amidst rising costs, we require our standard 30-day payment terms.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.30 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear your company team,

Your willingness to lower the price for faster payment suggests that payment timing is an important part of stability for your foundry. We value the long-standing relationship and want a transparent price basis that supports a sustainable agreement for both sides. How could we weigh payment timing alongside the underlying cost changes to reach that shared basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.23 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.14 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
